note: run settings of the grader (generated from the task values and the measured runtime budget, packages P01 / P03 / P24): six stations in up to three slots (one cell process and one program process each, pinned; queue order), one runner account per slot; program_time_cap_s caps the program's own time per station (the wall clock minus the cell's simulation and rendering, cellkit.wire), on one core (affinity locked); program_cpu_cap_s is only the CPU-limit backstop; station_watchdog_s bounds a hung station: one wave's share of the limit, (timeout_sec - 250 s) / 2 waves, above a station at all its budgets at the dearest measured position (3916 s; decision AM2-13, package P44); rerun_min_s, the time that must remain before the deadline for the single-station re-run, is the average share, (timeout_sec - 250 s) / (2 waves + 1 re-run); the budgets block is the cell's per-station budget (the practice facilities run the same numbers, simulated time per facility); every tolerance and world rule comes from data/task_values.json
